title: s'regayoV Client
description: This is the client pack to join my modded server mainly focused around Create
body:
# Technology and Automation

## The core of the pack lies in its integration of major technology mods:

- Create: featuring the main mod plus numerous specialized addons like Create Railways,
Create New Age (for power), and Create Diesel Generators, allowing for complex, kinetic automation and transport systems.

- Applied Energistics 2 (AE2): Provides advanced item and fluid storage networks, with complementary mods like AE2WTLib and Extra Disks.

- Mekanism: Offers high-tier industrial processing, energy generation, and powerful tools, complemented by modules like Mekanism: Generators and Mekanism: Tools.

- RFTools: The full RFTools library is included (Builder, Control, Dimensions, Storage), enabling construction automation, remote interaction, and custom dimension creation.
Exploration and Dimensions

## The world generation is significantly overhauled to provide vast, unique landscapes and multiple new dimensions to explore:

- World Generation: Terralith, Nullscape, and Dynamic Trees work together to create visually stunning and diverse Overworld and End landscapes. Structures are enhanced by YUNG's Better series (Mineshafts, Dungeons, Strongholds, etc.).

- New Dimensions: Features The Aether (plus Deep Aether) and Deeper and Darker, adding substantial exploration and new progression paths outside of the vanilla dimensions.
Quality of Life and Visuals

## A large selection of utility and visual mods ensures a smooth and immersive experience:
## 
- QoL: Sophisticated Backpacks and Sophisticated Storage provide advanced item management. Waystones and Xaero's Maps aid in navigation and travel.

- Building & Decor: Mods like Chipped, FramedBlocks, and a comprehensive suite of Macaw's mods (Bridges, Doors, Roofs, etc.) offer extensive creative building options.

- Performance: The pack utilizes numerous performance and optimization mods, including Sodium, Iris, Lithium, and ModernFix.
